scope: Frozen cloud selected from a specified formation history, single retarded static pole and canonical forces, Born ionization and Peters radiation. Cases flagged with negative harmonics also contain local first-order s-wave horizon loss. Axis response is a linear posterior diagnostic without feedback.

negative.scope: First-order horizon rates with finite-cloud outgoing partners; point checks, not an evolved negative-harmonic response.

directions.scope: Linear direction response on a prescribed coherent orbit. Relative angles and static rates are posterior diagnostics; no orbit feedback is included.
